title: Gene-regulation modules in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease revealed by single-nucleus ATAC-seq.
authors: Takeuchi, Fumihiko; Liang, Yi-Qiang; Shimizu-Furusawa, Hana; Isono, Masato; Ang, Mia Yang; Mori, Kotaro; Mori, Taizo; Kakazu, Eiji; Yoshio, Sachiyo; Kato, Norihiro
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单核ATAC-seq和机器学习分析NAFLD进展中的基因调控模块，虽涉及转录因子与基因调控关系，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: We investigated the progression of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease from fatty liver to steatohepatitis using single-nucleus and bulk ATAC-seq on the livers of rats fed a high-fat diet (HFD). Rats fed HFD for 4 wk developed fatty liver, and those fed HFD for 8 wk further progressed to steatohepatitis. We observed an increase in the proportion of inflammatory macrophages, consistent with the pathological progression. Utilizing machine learning, we divided global gene regulation into modules, wherein transcription factors within a module could regulate genes within the same module, reaffirming known regulatory relationships between transcription factors and biological processes. We identified core genes-central to co-expression and protein-protein interaction-for the biological processes discovered. Notably, a large part of the core genes overlapped with genes previously implicated in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Single-nucleus ATAC-seq, combined with data-driven statistical analysis, offers insight into in vivo global gene regulation as a combination of modules and assists in identifying core genes of relevant biological processes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用单核和批量ATAC-seq技术，对喂食高脂饮食（HFD）的大鼠肝脏进行了研究，探讨了非酒精性脂肪肝病从脂肪肝进展至脂肪性肝炎的过程。喂食HFD 4周的大鼠发展为脂肪肝，而喂食HFD 8周的大鼠则进一步进展为脂肪性肝炎。我们观察到炎症巨噬细胞比例的增加，这与病理进展相一致。利用机器学习，我们将全局基因调控划分为模块，其中模块内的转录因子能够调控同一模块内的基因，重申了转录因子与生物过程之间已知的调控关系。我们识别出了所发现生物过程的核心基因——这些基因在共表达和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中处于中心地位。值得注意的是，大部分核心基因与先前在非酒精性脂肪肝病中涉及的基因重叠。单核ATAC-seq结合数据驱动的统计分析，为体内全局基因调控作为模块组合提供了见解，并有助于识别相关生物过程的核心基因。
